premises.text: Remote clinics lack expensive or bulky hospital diagnostic tools needed for patient care
premises.evidence_span: clinics are not equipped to meet patients' needs. Many tools are available in large hospitals. are not accessible because they are expensive or too bulky

premises.text: OSCULT is an ultrasound solution on an iPad that captures images, annotations, measurements, and exam records
premises.evidence_span: We have built a new ultrasound solution working on an iPad

premises.text: Practitioners can send images and consult specialists remotely over cellular or Wi-Fi
premises.evidence_span: I can call a more experienced doctor in a major city hospital to get advice

premises.text: Priced at about one third of regular ultrasound devices (14,900 euros), targeting clinics and emergency use
premises.evidence_span: 14,900 euros, Ausgut is a great tool for emergency. This is one third of the price of the regular ultrasound device

premises.text: Also suited for medical education by broadcasting image streams to classrooms
premises.evidence_span: Oscult is also ready for education. It's an ideal tool for healthcare classroom, because you can instantly broadcast the image stream to a large audience

premises.text: CE/FDA approvals are on track to open US and European sales after emerging-market clinic trials
premises.evidence_span: CE Medical and FDA are on track to be approved by mid-next year, which will allow us to sell to US and European markets

value.text: Let local clinics better diagnose patients and connect to specialists to improve health without sending every case to hospital
value.evidence_span: local clinics can better diagnose and connect to specialists to improve the patient's health
